text:
ravi: Ran a config preview for switching 20% traffic to model-C on route /summaries and the console fast number shows +15% cost, but our staged replay says +1.5%.
mia: Fast preview doesn't consider KV cache and request coalescing. We have quick_estimator vs replay_estimator.
chen: Agree. Also noticed preview didn't flag per-model quota pressure. For some tenants model-C headroom goes from 40% -> 5% which should be a hard warn.
ux-ara: UX ask: show both estimates inline: Quick: +15% (fast) — Final: +1.5% (replay, loading). Add an Ops guidance panel with recommended telemetry sample rate bumps and mitigation steps.
ravi: API note: /v1/preview currently returns a single object. Suggest returning {preview_job_id, quick_estimate} and then an evented final_estimate when replay finishes. Console can poll /v1/preview/{id}/status.
mia: We should also stamp preview results with the exact cohort hashing version and the trace_window id used so replay and audit can be deterministic.
chen: For promote endpoint, please include recommended telemetry: {trace_rate: "10%", p99_sampling: "increase 1%->25%", alert_sensitivity: "lower threshold by 10%"} and an ops_playbook link.
ux-ara: UX note: make the ops card collapsible, show concise bullets and a copy button for CLI ops commands. Don't overwhelm the main preview box.
ops-bot: preview-bot: queued replay_estimator job 1796123456; ETA 22s.
mia: Implementation detail: for large accounts we'll return quick_estimate immediately and enqueue replay; for small accounts we can await replay inline. We should compute and return a confidence_interval with final_estimate.
chen: Also, surface per-route and per-model quota headroom in the preview response. If any headroom < 10% include a risk tag and suggested mitigations.
ravi: Action items: mia implement preview_job_id + replay hook; chen add quota headroom fields and risk tags; ux-ara mock ops card and dual-estimate UI; I'll run validation after replay.
ops-bot: preview-bot: job 1796123456 completed. final_estimate: +1.6% (ci -0.8..+3.9), replay_trace_id=rt-2026-11-20-179612.
